documents.content:
Team news, published 11 September 2026 at 14:00 UTC.
Saka trained fully on Thursday and is available for selection.
The manager was not asked about Timber.
Havertz will not travel.
Jesus returned to training this week after his knee injury.
Asked about the captain, he said: "Odegaard is at 80% and we will see."
Martinelli has trained twice since the international break.
White is in contention after a light knock.
One name on the sheet does not match any registered player.

Press conference notes. Published 11 September 2026.
Mount may be rested with three games in eight days.
On Zirkzee the manager gave no clear answer either way.
Fernandes has been managing a dead leg.

Squad update.
Dalot is expected to play a limited part.
